top_signals.title: AI Trade Stumbles After Tech Earnings, Oil Rallies: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks fell as megacap earnings failed to reassure investors about the rebound in the artificial intelligence trade, Chinese equities neared a bear market and escalating Middle East tensions drove oil prices higher. Treasuries and the yen gained on haven demand.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
